questions.question: Old Abraham made his chief servant swear an oath about his son Isaac. What did the servant promise to do?

answers.text: Teach Isaac to run the household

questions.question: Abraham told his servant that God would send someone ahead of the servant to help find a wife for Isaac. Who?
At a well, Abraham's servant prayed for a sign. When he asked a girl for a drink, what did he want her to do?

answers.text: Offer to water his camels too
Ask him to wait for her father
Ask him where his master lives

questions.question: Abraham's servant bowed and worshiped the LORD after meeting Rebekah at the well. What did he praise God for?

answers.text: His kindness and faithfulness to Abraham
Sending rain for the thirsty camels
